items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Paul Whiteman, if he had something that the people liked... we would have it to play at our dance

ctx.x: Do you remember the names of any of the bands at all that you listened to?

Well we played, we used to use some of Dixieland, their bands after they started, you see. And different fellas up the line like that would come. We'd get it from anybody. Paul Whiteman, if he had something that the people liked. Anybody, a band that had a good live record was selling good and then the public was liking it and then we would have it to play at our dance, you see, and he'd make a big hit.
Did you have certain, I keep forgetting that word, riffs?
